sections.heading: Canonical import policy
sections.text: import "std.console" { console; scan; }.library; Importing never grants capabilities. std.core and std.console exports retain their canonical core/prelude reference owners.

sections.heading: Packages and compiled interfaces
sections.text: The stdlib registry supplies visibility metadata. G180 package manifests and lockfiles describe content-addressed offline packages; an intrinsic namespace is not a fictitious shipped package. See docs/reference/packages/PACKAGE-MANIFEST-SPEC.md and LOCKFILE-SPEC.md. Serialized .ni declarations retain their original SymbolIds; intrinsic entries do not acquire fabricated IDs.

sections.heading: Negative applicability
sections.text: No additional source diagnostic is invented for this row. The stated receiver and profile bounds and the associated owner tests define admissibility.
